```ts
/**
 * Vitest test suite for the `ZodMiniCUID2` schema.
 *
 * The `ZodMiniCUID2` export is a Zod‐mini schema that validates CUID2 strings.
 * It is built on top of `ZodMiniStringFormat` and the core `ZodCUID2` implementation.
 *
 * The tests below cover:
 *   • Typical valid CUID2 values (generated by the official `cuid2` library)
 *   • Edge‑case values (empty string, wrong length, illegal characters)
 *   • Non‑string inputs (null, undefined, numbers, objects)
 *   • Schema API contract (`parse`, `safeParse`, `check`, `optional`, etc.)
 *   • The internal type guard (`_zod`) is correctly attached (runtime check)
 *
 * These tests are written for Vitest and assume that the library under test
 * correctly re‑exports its core utilities. Adjust import paths if your project
 * structure differs.
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { ZodMiniCUID2 } from './schemas.js';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helper: a few known‑good CUID2 strings (generated with cuid2 v1.0+)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const VALID_CUID2_EXAMPLES = [
  // length 24, alphanumeric, starts with "c" (standard for cuid2)
  'ckjrf6i9t0000b8kd5k7l5p9',
  'cjf4jlg5l0002v3o16uhb5fd',
  'cly3h5g9z0004x7r73vz2rkc',
];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helper: generate an obviously invalid CUID2 string of a given length
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function makeInvalidCUID2(length: number, filler = 'x'): string {
  // start with a wrong prefix and fill the rest with the filler character
  return 'x' + filler.repeat(length - 1);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test suite
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
describe('ZodMiniCUID2 schema', () => {
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1️⃣  Basic positive case – valid CUID2 strings are accepted
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should successfully parse valid CUID2 strings', () => {
    for (const cuid of VALID_CUID2_EXAMPLES) {
      // `parse` should return the original string unchanged
      const result = ZodMiniCUID2.parse(cuid);
      expect(result).toBe(cuid);

      // `safeParse` should report success
      const safe = ZodMiniCUID2.safeParse(cuid);
      expect(safe.success).toBe(true);
      expect(safe.data).toBe(cuid);
    }
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2️⃣  Reject empty string
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should reject an empty string', () => {
    const empty = '';
    expect(() => ZodMiniCUID2.parse(empty)).toThrowError();
    const safe = ZodMiniCUID2.safeParse(empty);
    expect(safe.success).toBe(false);
    // The default error message from the core validator contains “CUID2”
    expect(safe.error?.errors[0].message).toMatch(/CUID2/i);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3️⃣  Reject strings with wrong length
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should reject strings that are not the exact CUID2 length', () => {
    // CUID2 is expected to be 24 characters (this is the length used by the core impl)
    const tooShort = makeInvalidCUID2(20);
    const tooLong = makeInvalidCUID2(30);

    const cases = [tooShort, tooLong];
    for (const str of cases) {
      expect(() => ZodMiniCUID2.parse(str)).toThrowError();
      const safe = ZodMiniCUID2.safeParse(str);
      expect(safe.success).toBe(false);
      expect(safe.error?.errors[0].message).toMatch(/CUID2/i);
    }
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4️⃣  Reject strings containing illegal characters
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should reject strings that contain non‑alphanumeric characters', () => {
    const badChars = [
      'c!@#%^&*()_+{}|:"<>?~`', // symbols
      'cABCDEFGHIJKLMN@OPQRST', // symbol in the middle
      'c1234567890-abcdefghi',  // hyphen
    ];

    for (const str of badChars) {
      expect(() => ZodMiniCUID2.parse(str)).toThrowError();
      const safe = ZodMiniCUID2.safeParse(str);
      expect(safe.success).toBe(false);
      expect(safe.error?.errors[0].message).toMatch(/CUID2/i);
    }
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5️⃣  Non‑string inputs (null, undefined, number, object, array)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should reject non‑string inputs', () => {
    const nonStrings = [
      null,
      undefined,
      12345,
      true,
      false,
      { foo: 'bar' },
      ['c1234567890123456789012'],
    ] as const;

    for (const value of nonStrings) {
      // @ts-expect-error – we deliberately pass a wrong type
      expect(() => ZodMiniCUID2.parse(value)).toThrowError();
      // @ts-expect-error – same reason
      const safe = ZodMiniCUID2.safeParse(value);
      expect(safe.success).toBe(false);
      // The core validator typically reports “expected string”
      expect(safe.error?.errors[0].message).toMatch(/string/i);
    }
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 6️⃣  Optional schema – should allow undefined whilst still rejecting invalid strings
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should work correctly when made optional', () => {
    const optionalSchema = ZodMiniCUID2.optional();

    // undefined is now acceptable
    expect(optionalSchema.parse(undefined)).toBeUndefined();

    // valid string still passes
    expect(optionalSchema.parse(VALID_CUID2_EXAMPLES[0])).toBe(VALID_CUID2_EXAMPLES[0]);

    // invalid string still throws
    expect(() => optionalSchema.parse('invalid-cuid2')).toThrowError();
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 7️⃣  Nullable schema – should accept null as a valid value
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should work correctly when made nullable', () => {
    const nullableSchema = ZodMiniCUID2.nullable();

    // null is acceptable
    expect(nullableSchema.parse(null)).toBeNull();

    // valid string still passes
    expect(nullableSchema.parse(VALID_CUID2_EXAMPLES[1])).toBe(VALID_CUID2_EXAMPLES[1]);

    // invalid string still throws
    expect(() => nullableSchema.parse('')).toThrowError();
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 8️⃣  Ensure the internal Zod identifier (`_zod`) is attached
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should expose the internal core identifier via the `_zod` property', () => {
    // The interface declares `_zod: core.$ZodCUID2Internals;`
    // At runtime we expect the property to exist and be an object.
    // The exact shape is implementation‑specific, so we only check for presence.
    // @ts-ignore – accessing internal property for test purposes
    const internal = (ZodMiniCUID2 as any)._zod;
    expect(internal).toBeDefined();
    expect(typeof internal).toBe('object');
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // 9️⃣  Chaining behavior (e.g., .maxLength, .minLength) – should be unavailable
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  it('should not expose unrelated string methods like maxLength/minLength', () => {
    // The schema is purposely limited to CUID2 validation; such methods must be undefined.
    // @ts-ignore – we intentionally access possibly‑non‑existent members
    expect(typeof ZodMiniCUID2.maxLength).toBe('undefined');
    // @ts-ignore
    expect(typeof ZodMiniCUID2.minLength).toBe('undefined');
  });
});
```
